authority: #K2-438 sec.3.3: the sec.16.3 four-element scheme-layer artifact for the five residuals of the R1286 run. Zero exam runs, zero board change. Nothing here is a claim of success; it is the drawing the next authorised run must obey.
element1_one_line_death_cause: All five residuals are dR-CROSSING or PLANE-TIE nets (NRST / I2C1_SDA / P3V3_AUX x2 / P3V3): the wipe cut them at x=51.5 and left a dangling half-stub outside dR; the in-frame maze refused them (no-free-start-node x3, no-path-coarse(exhausted-1) x1, + one further I2C1_SDA pair) because the drawing never gave it a dR PORT to land on nor a PLANE TIE for the POWER pads. AND - proven in the run's own chain - the functional-block channel hand-off crashed (UnboundLocalError) so the maze ran with NO channel constraint at all.
element2_proven_facts: run chain verbatim: route.chain[0] == {stage: channels_compute_failed, err: UnboundLocalError} => --channels was EMPTY (k2_reroute_router_floor_v1 --channels default ''); the maze ran unbounded.
regen.py:1413 uses d0 before it is assigned at 1437 => see K2_CHANNEL_WIRING_DEFECT_RECEIPT_v1 (D-1).

channels_arg_by_block(wiped, d0, rect) -> '' because multi_block_plan is INFEASIBLE (D-2); the fallback channels_arg(...) returns a NON-EMPTY row-grouped reach-inclusive set (so a correct wiring would at least give the maze the reach-inclusive channels).
functional_blocks / multi_block_plan / per_block_flow have no production caller other than the (ineffective) channels_arg_by_block (D-3/D-4).

maze ledger, second pass, per-net named reasons: NRST no-free-start-node (dist 25.279) / P3V3_AUX no-path-coarse(exhausted-1) (5.55) / P3V3_AUX no-free-start-node (7.396) / P3V3 no-free-start-node (52.543).
raw run DRC /tmp/opencode/k1/s4_drc.json: unconnected_items = 5 entries over 4 nets (P3V3_AUX twice) => C1 counts ITEMS (5), the in-chain per_block_C1_gate counts DISTINCT NETS (4).
every one of the five shares ONE named cause string: 'maze refused at these endpoints; direct stitch FORBIDDEN (#K2-411 sec.2)' => OLD class, no new failure introduced.
the four nets all have copper on BOTH sides of dR (measured on the judged board): NRST 11 inside / 8 outside tracks; I2C1_SDA 82 / 146; P3V3_AUX 40 / 41; P3V3 82 / 82.

PLANE FACTS (HitTestFilledArea on the judged board, In4.Cu): P3V3_AUX plane FILLED at C90.1 (29.65,53.5) and at (50.95,37.0); P3V3 plane FILLED at (81.0,60.6) but NOT at C84.1 (43.4,44.0); the in-frame P3V3 In4 finger is filled at (43.4,39.0).
PAD FACTS: C84.1 (P3V3) and C90.1 (P3V3_AUX) are SMD pads on F.Cu ONLY (pad attribute SMD, drill 0.0); NO footprint carries a P3V3/P3V3_AUX pad on In4 => a VIA is the only plane tie.

SOLVER-DOMAIN FACT: the maze is called with --bound-rect <frame>; a net whose in-frame piece must land on a half-cut stub at x=51.5 has no in-frame free start cell beyond the boundary => no-free-start-node.
